story.summaryEn:
Celebrating trackside communities in Austin. 💚
Jess and Mathilda joined us to meet members of @GATG_F1 at the #USGP to say thank you for the growing community they are a part of, making safe spaces for females to enjoy motorsport across the globe.
detailZh:
庆祝奥斯汀赛道社区活动 💚
杰斯和玛蒂尔德加入我们，在美赛车会与@GATG_F1成员见面，感谢他们为全球女性赛车爱好者提供的增长社区，让他们享受赛车运动的安全空间。
